name: motion-cadence-twos
title: On Ones / Twos / Threes
description: Giữ mỗi hình qua nhiều khung (12 hoặc 8 hình mỗi giây) để chuyển động có chất vẽ tay thay vì mượt tuyệt đối.

moworks.author: moworks

options.fps: drawings a second: 24 ones, 12 twos, 8 threes (12)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Keep the motion's own ease but hold each value on a fixed drawing rate: ones = 24 drawings/s (alternate 2 and 3 frames at 60 fps), twos = 12/s (hold 5 frames), threes = 8/s (alternate 7 and 8 frames). Small demo: three dots ping-pong 230 px (1 s each way, linear) sampled at 24 / 12 / 8 fps. Param fps (or a film-level cadence) snaps the progress to that grid. Params: cadence: ones | twos | threes (24 / 12 / 8 hình mỗi giây) · ease: giữ nguyên ease gốc. The motion keeps its own ease; only its progress is held on the drawing rate.
